app.name: HR Action
app.tagline: Hourly leaves, vacations, advances and deductions in one place

login.title: Log in

employees.defaultPasswordHint: First password = phone number; the employee changes it at first login.

settings.weekendHint: Weekend days are not counted against the vacation balance.

import.help: Upload an Excel file with the employees. The first row holds the column titles. Each new employee's first password is their phone number.
import.columns: Columns: Name, Phone (required) — Position, Department, Branch, Salary, Hire date, Email, Role (optional). Arabic titles work too.
import.updateExisting: Update employees that already exist (password is not changed)
